description: Human-readable analyst brief: BLUF, key judgments, and ICD-203 confidence assessment for a threat actor, optionally scoped to a sector. Same fan-out data as /ot/report but synthesised into a short decision-ready brief instead of a full report. Price: $0.12 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

actor.description: ICS threat actor name e.g. SANDWORM, VOLTZITE, XENOTIME

sector.description: Optional target sector e.g. energy, water, manufacturing
